dct_title_s: Village Points  Ayeyarwady Region PCode v9.6
dct_description_sm: Village locations (points) in Ayeyarwady Region, based on the latest MIMU Pcode version 9.6 . Place names from General Administration Department (GAD), are available in Myanmar Unicode. Transliteration in roman script by MIMU. Place names are in line with the general cartographic practice to reflect the names of such places as designated by the host governments. The United Nations encourages the Government of Myanmar to review place names which include terms that may be viewed or perceived as derogatory.
